newsitem.title: UK: Hambro to sell Beale Dobie to Fedsure.
newsitem.headline: Hambro to sell Beale Dobie to Fedsure.

text.p: Hambro Insurance Services said on Friday it plans to sell Beale Dobie & Co to Fedsure Investments for 17.4 million pounds ($29 million) to Fedsure Investments (UK) Ltd.

HIS said Beale Dobie is one of the UK's leading market makers in traded endowment policies with approximately 15 percent of the market. The audited net assets of Beale Dobie on the year ended March 31 were 2.7 million pounds and the audited profit before taxation for the year 1.8 million.
HIS owns 75 percent of the issued share capital of Beale Dobie with the balance being owned equally by David Beale, Christopher Dobie and his family trusts and Chasophie Ltd.
Beale and Dobie are joint chief executives of Beale Dobie and Dobie is a director of HIS. Under the terms of the agreement, the minority holders are also selling their holdings in Beale Dobie.
HIS said the sale enables it to focus on developing and expanding the range and scale of support services it provides to the insurance and other industries.
It said there are considerable opportunities to expand the operations of Hambro Assistance, its claims management and helpline assistance business both organically and through acquisition.
